name: Jules Walters
occupation: State Representative; former mayor of West Linn

bio.statement: The Oregon Legislature biography says Walters is a parent of four who served as mayor of West Linn.
bio.excerpt: as mayor of West Linn, a community of over 30,000 people.

bio.statement: Ballotpedia lists Walters's career as including administrative assistant, business owner, vice president of operations, and mayor of West Linn.
bio.excerpt: She served as mayor of West Linn.

positions.statement: In March 2025 reporting republished by the Portland Tribune, Walters said substance use disorder is often thought of as an adult disease and that this is not how it works.
positions.excerpt: We think of (substance use disorder) as an adult disease, and that is not how it works.

voting_record.statement: The Lund Report, republished by the Portland Tribune, identified Walters as one of the chief co-sponsors of a trio of 2025 bills on youth substance use.
voting_record.excerpt: "We just have these giant gaps for youth," said Walters, one of the bills' chief co-sponsors
